correctness.rationale: For smooth input cubics, split-variable derivatives prove smoothness; fixed eigenblocks give precisely the elliptic curve and three points. The block projection is generically a degree-three cyclic cover with a single orbit per fiber, proving rationality. Equivariant local coordinates yield the two asserted cyclic types and Reid–Tai ages. Quasi-étale adjunction and degree give \((-K_Y)^3=8\). Transfer plus the Lefschetz trace and Jacobian-ring eigenweights independently give \(b_3=4\) and the Hodge dimensions. CHECK.py tests only exact derived arithmetic, not the full proof.

value.rationale: The central order-three action arises from a natural and exceptional equivariant birational obstruction on a smooth nonrational cubic threefold. Its coarse quotient has the opposite ordinary birational behavior (rationality) yet retains a noncanonical elliptic singular stratum, separate canonical isolated points, and nontrivial rank-four middle cohomology. A uniform complete calculation for all split smooth cubics is a motivated quotient-geometry classification with implications for singular and Hodge geometry, not a parameter-renaming or numerical toy.
